newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTO'S COSTA BROKE NOSE IN END-MATCH SCUFFLE.
newsitem.headline: PORTO'S COSTA BROKE NOSE IN END-MATCH SCUFFLE.

text.p: Porto defender Jorge Costa needed nose surgery after a scuffle involving Milan's Liberian striker George Weah at the end of a bad-tempered European Champions' League clash on Wednesday, a hospital source said.
Porto club doctor Domingos Gomes told reporters that an X-ray on Thursday had shown broken bones in the defender's nose and that he would be out of action for about three weeks.
The match, which ended in a 1-1 draw, was littered with fouls and yellow cards.

Porto coach Antonio Oliveira said that the incident had been reported to UEFA officials present at the game in which the Portuguese side assured themselves of finishing top of Group D of the Champions' League phase of the European Cup.
Milan still need a point from their final match against Norway's Rosenborg to be assured of reaching the quarter-finals of a competition they have wion five times.
